subject: [Invite] SF AI leaders dinner with Rivian, Glydways, BotCo - 10/30
text:
Hi [NAME],

We're hosting a private AI leaders dinner next Thursday (30 Oct,
6:30-9:30pm) at Spruce in SF with Founders and Heads of AI from Rivian,
Glydways, 1X, Dexterity, BotCo, and Genesis AI. We'd love for you to join
us.

It's a small group (~25 guests) hosted by our Co-Founder, [SENDER], focused on
the multimodal shift in AI; how vision is converging with language,
robotics, and embodied systems.

For context, Encord is fast becoming the de facto ML data layer for many
physical AI companies (Woven (Toyota), Boston Dynamics, Thinking Machine
Labs and more) to help unify 2D and 3D sensor fusion pipelines. We're big
fans of Monarch, so keen to meet you there.

Would you be up for joining? I can send over the full invite.
